knimeNode.name: Spark String to Number(HYIM)
knimeNode.shortDescription: Converts String columns to numeric types (Integer, Double, Long) in a Spark DataFrame.

intro.p: This node converts selected String columns in a Spark DataFrame to numeric types (Integer, Double, or Long). It supports configurable decimal and thousands separators, optional type suffix handling (d/D/f/F), and error handling.
Values that cannot be parsed are set to missing (null) by default. Enable "Fail on error" to abort execution when conversion fails.

tab.name: Column Selection
tab.option: Select the String columns to convert to numbers. Only String-type columns from the input Spark DataFrame are shown.

tab.name: Parsing Options
tab.option: The target numeric type: Integer (32-bit), Double (64-bit floating point), or Long (64-bit integer).
Character used as decimal point. Default is '.'. Leave empty to use default.
Character used as thousands grouping separator. Leave empty to disable thousands separator handling.

option.name: Accept type suffix (d, D, f, F)

tab.option: If checked, numeric strings ending with d/D/f/F suffixes (e.g. "1.5d") are accepted. If unchecked, such values are treated as conversion errors.
If checked, the node fails when any value cannot be converted. If unchecked, unconvertible values become missing (null).

ports.inPort: Spark DataFrame containing String columns to convert.
ports.outPort: Spark DataFrame with selected columns converted to numeric types.
